prompt:
Hyper-realistic cinematic double portrait composite — photorealistic large monochrome ghost portrait combined with a sharp full-color full-body walking portrait of the same man, framed within a glowing neon diamond outline, moody smoky studio backdrop, zero flat AI look.

CONCEPT — EXACT: A layered composite where a large black-and-white close-up portrait fills the upper background against a smoky dark backdrop with diagonal light-beam accents, a glowing warm-white neon diamond outline frames the lower two-thirds of the frame, and a smaller sharp full-color full-body walking portrait of the same man stands centered within the diamond frame in the foreground.

BACKGROUND GHOST PORTRAIT — EXACT: Large black-and-white close-up portrait, head turned slightly to the side, calm composed gaze, voluminous tousled dark hair, dark square-frame sunglasses, wearing a suit jacket collar visible at the shoulder, rendered entirely in monochrome grey tones, softly blended into the smoky backdrop.

MAIN SUBJECT — FOREGROUND — EXACT: Full-body walking portrait, man standing with one hand tucked into his trouser pocket, other hand adjusting the lapel of his jacket with a wristwatch visible, voluminous tousled dark hair, dark round sunglasses, calm confident expression, thin necklace chain visible at the open collar.

BODY: Lean athletic build, natural proportionate physique, relaxed confident standing posture.

OUTFIT: Light-grey tailored blazer worn open over a black button-up shirt, black tailored trousers, black leather loafers, dark round sunglasses, silver wristwatch, thin necklace chain.

NEON DIAMOND FRAME DETAIL — EXACT: A glowing warm-white neon diamond-shaped outline surrounding the lower two-thirds of the frame around the foreground subject, soft glow bloom along the neon line, diagonal light-beam streaks crossing the upper background at varying angles.

LIGHTING — EXACT: Soft even studio lighting on the foreground subject from the front, flat neutral lighting on the monochrome background portrait, warm glow spill from the neon diamond outline onto the floor and lower body, drifting smoke/fog catching subtle light throughout the background, no harsh shadows on the face.

BACKGROUND — EXACT: Dark charcoal-black smoky studio backdrop with soft drifting fog, diagonal light-beam streaks crossing the upper portion, reflective dark floor surface beneath the subject's feet.

promptZh:
超写实电影感双重肖像合成 —— 照片级逼真的大型单色幽灵肖像，结合同一男子清晰的全彩全身行走肖像，置于发光的霓虹钻石轮廓内，营造出烟雾缭绕的摄影棚氛围，杜绝平庸的 AI 感。

概念 — 精确：分层合成效果，大型黑白特写肖像填充上方背景，背景为烟雾缭绕的暗色调，带有对角线光束点缀；发光的暖白色霓虹钻石轮廓勾勒出画面下三分之二区域；前景中，同一男子的较小清晰全彩全身行走肖像居于钻石框内。

背景幽灵肖像 — 精确：大型黑白特写肖像，头部略微转向一侧，神情冷静从容，浓密凌乱的深色头发，佩戴深色方框太阳镜，肩部可见西装领，完全以单色灰调呈现，柔和地融入烟雾背景中。

主体 — 前景 — 精确：全身行走肖像，男子单手插在裤兜里，另一只手整理西装翻领，可见腕表，浓密凌乱的深色头发，深色圆框太阳镜，神情冷静自信，领口处可见细项链。

身材：精瘦健壮，自然匀称的体格，放松自信的站姿。

服装：浅灰色定制西装外套敞开穿着，内搭黑色衬衫，黑色定制长裤，黑色皮质乐福鞋，深色圆框太阳镜，银色腕表，细项链。

霓虹钻石边框细节 — 精确：发光的 暖白色 霓虹钻石形轮廓，环绕前景主体周围的画面下三分之二区域，霓虹线条边缘带有柔和的光晕，对角线光束以不同角度穿过上方背景。

光影 — 精确：前景主体采用柔和均匀的摄影棚正面光，单色背景肖像采用平坦的中性光，霓虹钻石轮廓发出暖光，投射在地面和下半身，漂浮的烟雾/雾气在整个背景中捕捉到微妙的光线，面部无生硬阴影。

背景 — 精确：深炭黑色烟雾缭绕的摄影棚背景，带有柔和的漂浮雾气，对角线光束穿过上方区域，主体脚下为反光深色地面。
